entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about returning an item. It's the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF-PULSE-88145.

Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 30th, so about 18 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a preference. It works fine, but I honestly just **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy** after the holidays, and I just **don't use it** like I thought I would.
I understand. Sometimes a new gadget doesn't quite fit into the daily routine. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay. I know I'm a little past the two-week mark, so I was hoping maybe we could work something out, like a store credit or even a partial refund? I'd be willing to discuss options.
Thank you for your patience, Sarah... Alright, I've consulted our policy, and it looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? 10 days? I thought for sure it would be shorter. That's fantastic.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 18, I can approve this for a full refund to your original payment method. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just pack the band back in its box and drop it at the post office.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
